  rmarkdown::html_vignette:
    self_contained: false
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{FishSET GUI Quickstart Guide}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Try to find the file in the installed package
guide_path <- system.file("extdata", "FishSET_GUI_Quickstart_Content.html", package = "FishSET")

# Fallback for clicking "Knit" in RStudio before installing the package
if (guide_path == "") {
  guide_path <- "../inst/extdata/FishSET_GUI_Quickstart_Content.html"
}

if (!file.exists(guide_path)) {
  stop("Could not find FishSET_GUI_Quickstart_Content.html at: ", guide_path)
}

  htmltools::includeHTML(guide_path)

```
